svg.text: Encoder kernels on a Tesla T4: time against threads launched (batch A)
GPT-2 small, 4 x 1024 tokens, 32 launches per kernel. Dot: median of 6 runs; bar: fastest to slowest run.
threads launched = blocks x threads per block (log scale)
40,960: all the threads a T4 holds at once
